description: This file is a shell script designed to run a series of tests on the 'trace2' performance (perf) feature in Git. It sets up environment variables, dependencies, and configurations, then runs various test cases to verify the correct generation and content of trace output related to performance measurement, nested processes, counters, URLs, command parameters, and alias expansions.

methods.name: try_simple
methods.description: Runs a command with specific environment variables and verifies that certain performance parameters and command names are correctly recorded in the trace output.

methods.name: have_timer_event
methods.description: Checks if a specific timer event with given parameters exists in the trace output file.

methods.name: have_counter_event
methods.description: Checks if a specific counter event with given parameters exists in the trace output file.
